digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud S3-backed live test suite
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite is needed to cover the S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume across real projects REB and DIG, complementing the existing Data Center harness.
The suite must be structurally unable to perform Jira mutations via monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, etc.) to raise JiraWriteForbidden.
The test harness uses an isolated S3 store with a throwaway git-remote-s3 prefix, never production, deleted on teardown, ensuring no mutation of Cloud or production storage.

Core scenarios validate multi-project mapping, per-project fetch scoping, dry-run preview mode, S3 round-trip integrity, fail-closed behavior for unknown projects, and proof that the read-only guard is functional.
The suite is gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL environment variable and Jira/AWS credentials, and is wired into CI as a dedicated jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal workflow job.
